item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"“This indicates a likely bar-shape mismatch, not necessarily a skill defect.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"“That template turns the eval into a conformance test and can produce false failures even when the underlying judgment is good.”","status":"pass"},"O3":{"citation":"“Do not alter the skill merely to teach it the seven-heading test.”","status":"pass"},"O4":{"citation":"The artifact says to verify the evaluation mode, rewrite the bar around outcomes and smells, and “Echo the revised bar back for agreement,” but it does not explicitly call for clarifying the skill’s first principles with the user before replacing the bar.","status":"fail"},"O5":{"citation":"“Only failures that remain under a defensible, judgment-shaped bar should drive edits to the skill.” This requires a corrected-case failure, but does not require identifying a named behavior defect before editing.","status":"fail"},"S1":{"citation":"Smell absent: the artifact says the result is “not necessarily a skill defect.”","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Smell absent: it says, “Do not alter the skill merely to teach it the seven-heading test.”","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Smell absent: it calls for verifying whether the skill is judgment-oriented and rewriting the prescriptive bar around outcomes and failure smells.","status":"pass"},"S4":{"citation":"Smell absent: no invented first principles are substituted for clarification; the artifact calls for echoing the revised bar “back for agreement.”","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Smell absent: it rejects reproducing “an exact seven-heading template” and says artifacts should instead make “sound, defensible decisions.”","status":"pass"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The artifact correctly diagnoses a likely bad-bar problem, distinguishes judgment evaluation from template conformance, and refuses template-chasing edits.
